title: SMPP delivery
description: SMS delivery observed by DeepFlow's eBPF agent with the SMPP plugin. https://github.com/MadhuAithal/deepflow-smpp-plugin

panels.title: Accepted
panels.description: Submits the operator accepted (it returned a message ID). Each message counted once.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS accepted FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id)

panels.title: Delivered
panels.description: Share of accepted messages with a DELIVRD receipt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, countIf(r.stat = 'DELIVRD') / count()) AS delivered
FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id) AS a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.message_id')] AS id,
         min(start_time) AS received,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_stat')], start_time) AS stat,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_err')], start_time) AS err,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS rdest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'deliver_sm'
    AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.command')] = 'deliver_sm' AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt')] = 'true'
    AND time >= $__fromTime
  GROUP BY id) AS r ON a.id = r.id

panels.title: Refused
panels.description: Submits the operator refused (throttled, rejected, system error).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(max(c), 0) AS refused FROM (SELECT observation_point, count() AS c 
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code IS NOT NULL AND response_code != 0
    AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY observation_point)

  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,

panels.title: Deliver p95
panels.description: From the operator accepting a message to its DELIVRD receipt, 95th percentile.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantile(0.95)((toUnixTimestamp64Micro(r.received) - toUnixTimestamp64Micro(a.submitted)) / 1e6) AS p95_s
FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id) AS a
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.message_id')] AS id,
         min(start_time) AS received,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_stat')], start_time) AS stat,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_err')], start_time) AS err,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS rdest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'deliver_sm'
    AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.command')] = 'deliver_sm' AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt')] = 'true'
    AND time >= $__fromTime
  GROUP BY id) AS r ON a.id = r.id
WHERE r.stat = 'DELIVRD'

panels.title: Submits: accepted vs refused
panels.description: Accepted and refused submits per interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(submitted) AS t, count() AS accepted
FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id)
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT t, max(c) AS refused FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, observation_point, count() AS c 
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code IS NOT NULL AND response_code != 0
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY t, observation_point)
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Submit latency
panels.description: How long the operator took to accept each message (submit_sm to submit_sm_resp).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(submitted) AS t,
       avg(latency_us) / 1000 AS avg_ms,
       quantile(0.95)(latency_us) / 1000 AS p95_ms
FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id)
WHERE latency_us > 0
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id) AS a
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.message_id')] AS id,
         min(start_time) AS received,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_stat')], start_time) AS stat,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_err')], start_time) AS err,

SELECT if(r.id IS NULL, 'NO RECEIPT YET', r.stat) AS outcome, count() AS messages
FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id) AS a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.message_id')] AS id,
         min(start_time) AS received,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_stat')], start_time) AS stat,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_err')], start_time) AS err,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS rdest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'deliver_sm'
    AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.command')] = 'deliver_sm' AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt')] = 'true'
    AND time >= $__fromTime
  GROUP BY id) AS r ON a.id = r.id
GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY messages DESC
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.title: Refusal reasons
panels.description: Why the operator refused submits (SMPP command_status).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT reason, max(c) AS submits FROM (
  SELECT observation_point, if(response_exception = '', toString(response_code), response_exception) AS reason, count() AS c
  
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code IS NOT NULL AND response_code != 0
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY observation_point, reason)
GROUP BY reason ORDER BY submits DESC

panels.title: Messages
panels.description: Every accepted message: when, where to (masked), latency, delivery time and outcome.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.submitted AS submitted,
       a.id AS message_id,
       if(a.dest != '', a.dest, ifNull(r.rdest, '')) AS destination,
       if(a.latency_us > 0, a.latency_us / 1000, NULL) AS submit_latency_ms,
       if(r.id IS NULL, NULL, (toUnixTimestamp64Micro(r.received) - toUnixTimestamp64Micro(a.submitted)) / 1e6) AS delivered_in_s,
       if(r.id IS NULL, 'no receipt yet', r.stat) AS outcome,
       if(r.err IN ('', '000') OR r.err IS NULL, '', r.err) AS error
FROM (
  SELECT response_result AS id,
         min(start_time) AS submitted,
         maxIf(response_duration, type = 2) AS latency_us,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS dest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'submit_sm' AND type IN (1, 2)
    AND response_code = 0 AND response_result != ''
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY id) AS a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.message_id')] AS id,
         min(start_time) AS received,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_stat')], start_time) AS stat,
         argMin(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt_err')], start_time) AS err,
         any(attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.dest_prefix')]) AS rdest
  FROM flow_log.l7_flow_log
  WHERE (server_port = ${smpp_port} OR client_port = ${smpp_port}) AND request_type = 'deliver_sm'
    AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.command')] = 'deliver_sm' AND attribute_values[indexOf(attribute_names, 'smpp.receipt')] = 'true'
    AND time >= $__fromTime
  GROUP BY id) AS r ON a.id = r.id
ORDER BY submitted DESC
LIMIT 200
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
